answer: In a decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol, stake-slashing matrices ensure Sybil resistance by imposing substantial economic costs on attackers. An attacker attempting to create multiple identities faces a haven of prohibitive capital lockup and negative expected utility, akin to sowing seeds in a garden that returns bitter fruit. This mechanism sustains Byzantine Fault Tolerance, as autonomous agents collaboratively maintain system integrity, effectively filtering out malicious Sybils and preserving the echo of genuine contributors.
